notes: A STALLED HANDSHAKE IS TRIED AGAIN ON A FRESH SOCKET. The secure handshake now runs under the connect's own 3-second clock: a handshake that stalls is abandoned with its socket and a new attempt made at once, instead of surfacing as an error that skipped the candidate. Since 1.3.81: the judge stops describing candidates once the folder has what it needs; since 1.3.80: a stalled read is tried again at once and a stalled download resumes.
